Cucumber HTML Reporter

Source: R/report-html.R
CucumberHtmlReporter.Rd

Writes the run as the official Cucumber HTML report (https://github.com/cucumber/html-formatter). To also see the progress of the run, combine it with another reporter in a CucumberMultiReporter. To write the report of a run after it ran, store its messages with CucumberMessagesReporter and pass their file to report().

Behavior






Feature: HTML reporter


CucumberHtmlReporter writes the official Cucumber HTML report of a run when the run ends,
even when it fails. The page is one file, with the report's script and styles and the
messages of the run, so it works offline. It can be searched and filtered by status, text and tags.

Scenario: The attachments of a step are shown under it


A screenshot and the logs attached when a step fails are shown under the step that failed.
  • Given a file named "features/basket.feature" with

    Feature: Basket
  Scenario: Add an item
    When I add an item
    • 

  • And a file named "features/setup-steps.R" with
    when("I add an item", function(context) stop("The basket is full"))
after_step(function(context, step) {
  if (step$status == "failed") {
    png("basket.png")
    plot(1:3)
    dev.off()
    context$attach(readBin("basket.png", "raw", file.size("basket.png")), "image/png", file_name = "basket.png")
    context$log("Opened the basket")
  }
})
    • 

  • When I run
    test("features", reporter = CucumberHtmlReporter$new("report.html"), stop_on_failure = FALSE)
    • 

  • Then the HTML report "report.html" shows these attachments:
    stepkindcontent
    When I add an itemimagebasket.png
    When I add an itemtextOpened the basket
    •

Method new()


Create an HTML reporter


Usage


CucumberHtmlReporter$new(file = "cucumber-report.html")







Arguments


file


Path of the HTML file to write, replaced by each run. A
relative path is relative to the working directory when the reporter
is created. Its directory is created when the reporter is, if it
doesn't exist.

Examples

    
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cucumber::test(reporter = cucumber::CucumberHtmlReporter$new("cucumber-report.html"))

# With the progress of the run
cucumber::test(reporter = cucumber::CucumberMultiReporter$new(list(
  cucumber::CucumberProgressReporter$new(),
  cucumber::CucumberHtmlReporter$new("cucumber-report.html")
)))

# From the messages of a run, after it ran
cucumber::test(reporter = cucumber::CucumberMessagesReporter$new("cucumber.ndjson"))
cucumber::CucumberHtmlReporter$new("cucumber-report.html")$report("cucumber.ndjson")
} # }
